Method of Attack: Ransomware encrypting files with .babyk extension and dropping ransom note 'How To Restore Your Files.txt'
Customized ransomware executables created using leaked Babuk Locker builder targeting Windows, VMware ESXi, NAS x86, and NAS ARM devices
Indicators of Compromise: ransom note named How To Restore Your Files.txt
Attack Vector: Use of leaked Babuk Locker ransomware builder uploaded to VirusTotal
Ransomware distributed via unknown methods, communication via email
